label: towers
how: OpenCelliD export for Egypt (MCC 602), kept the four national operators and dropped rows with missing coordinates or zero range.

label: events per second
how: The simulator sends one event per tower every 5 seconds, so 10,192 / 5 = 2,038 events per second, sustained on a local Docker stack.

label: alert latency
how: Sum of the measured stage latencies from the simulator to the regional_alerts topic (10 + 50 + 20 + 50 + 20 ms upper bounds).

label: Compose services
how: Kafka, Kafka UI, Flink jobmanager and taskmanager, Iceberg REST catalog, PostgreSQL, Airflow and Grafana.

label: records
how: Rows parsed from the access log. 10,241,992 remain after cleaning, about 1.2% removed.

label: raw to Parquet
how: Size of the raw text log against the parsed Parquet output, 93% smaller.

label: end to end
how: Wall clock time for all four stages on a local Docker setup.

label: lookup rows
how: Rows in the IP to hostname lookup used by the enrichment DAG.

label: source tables
how: Three CRM tables (sales, customers, products) and three ERP tables (customers, locations, categories).

label: customer rows
how: Raw CRM customer rows before deduplication in Silver.

label: layers
how: One schema per layer in SQL Server.

label: Gold model
how: fact_sales with dim_customers and dim_products, created as views.
